topics.title: ATM ở Phú Quốc

claims.claim: Agribank reported in 2020 that its Phú Quốc branch had one 24/7 CDM/Autobank and five ATMs. This is historical evidence only, not a current 2026 inventory.

Vietcombank officially updated three Phú Quốc banking access addresses effective 01/12/2025: 1A Hùng Vương in Dương Đông, 199 Nguyễn Văn Cừ in An Thới and 193 Nguyễn Trung Trực in Dương Đông. These addresses do not by themselves prove exterior 24/7 ATM availability.

topics.title: Pharmacy

claims.claim: Long Châu's official page identifies a branch at 46 Nguyễn Văn Cừ, An Thới, Đặc khu Phú Quốc, tỉnh An Giang.
Long Châu gives a general system operating window of 06:00-23:00 but explicitly says hours vary by store, so this must not be assigned to every branch without branch-level confirmation.
Indexed snapshots of Long Châu's own Phú Quốc store list expose inconsistent branch counts, so the current island-wide count remains unconfirmed.

sources.title: Hệ thống nhà thuốc tại 46 Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Đặc khu Phú Quốc

topics.title: Clinic / Hospital

claims.claim: Vinmec's current official directory places Vinmec Phú Quốc Hospital at Khu Bãi Dài, Đặc khu Phú Quốc, tỉnh An Giang, hotline 0297 3985 588.
Vinmec's emergency/ICU department states it operates 24/24 every day, including weekends and holidays.
Vinmec's current facility directory lists a Dương Đông general clinic at 114 Nguyễn Trung Trực, Khu phố 4, Đặc khu Phú Quốc, tỉnh An Giang.
